the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R This Special Leave Petition is filed by the brother of the victim, challenging the order passed by the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad ordering the release of the respondent no.2 on bail, in a criminal case for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 498A, 304B, 302, 201, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, read with Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,1961.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: We have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel appearing for the respondent no.2.
The First Information Report in this case was filed on 18.12.2020.
Respondent no.2 was arrested on 18.02.2021.
The charge sheet was filed on 16.05.2021 and the High Court ordered the release of the respondent no.2 by the impugned order dated 22.03.2022.
Thus, it is clear that the respondent no.2 has been granted bail after suffering incarceration for a period of more than one year.
The chargesheet was filed almost two years ago.
The trial has not yet commenced.
As pointed out by the High Court, respondent no.2 was working as a Sailor in the Coast Guard.
Therefore, the question of respondent no.2 escaping from the clutches of law may not arise.
However, the grievance of the petitioner is about the observation made by the High Court that there is no evidence on record to connect the respondent no.2 herein with the commission of crime.
This observation can be taken care of by making suitable observations.
Therefore, we are of the view that the order of the High Court granting bail to the respondent no.2 does not call for any interference.
However, we make it clear that any observation contained in the impugned order will not have a bearing upon the trial of respondent no.2.
